recognize_zh: 紅血球大小相近、色素正常，但可見多顆一端拉長成尾巴狀的淚滴形紅血球（dacrocytes），另有兩顆含粗大嗜鹼性點彩（basophilic stippling）的紅血球，提示骨髓纖維化造成的髓外造血與紅血球生成異常。
features: Several dacrocytes (teardrop cells) with single tapered tails
Normocytic normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis and ovalocytes
Two red cells with coarse basophilic stippling
No nucleated red cells or immature granulocytes in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, including several dacrocytes and ovalocytes. Two red cells display coarse basophilic stippling. Platelets are present and unremarkable, and no leukocytes, nucleated red cells or immature granulocytes are present in this field. Findings are consistent with a myelofibrotic process, compatible with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in the given context; confirmation requires assessment for leukoerythroblastosis and marrow reticulin fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Blood findings are identical, so the distinction rests on a documented prior history of polycythemia vera.
Also causes teardrop cells and a leukoerythroblastic picture, but marrow biopsy shows keratin-positive tumor cells.
Show basophilic stippling with microcytic hypochromic red cells rather than normocytic cells with prominent teardrops.
